annotations.title: What happened since I last looked

description: What happened on the account while you were away: fills, rejections, approvals, positions closed (stop, take-profit, plan, liquidation), plan rules fired, price alerts, warnings near liquidation or the daily loss limit. TradeHub remembers where you stopped, so a new session gets only what is new. Use at the start of a session, or with wait_seconds (up to 30) to wait for the next event. Not for current state (use get_my_open_positions). Inputs: types, limit, after (keep your own place). Next: act on what changed, e.g. get_my_open_positions.

after.description: An event id (last_event_id of an earlier answer) to read after it and keep your own place; leave out to continue from where you last checked
after.title: After

wait_seconds.description: When nothing is new, wait up to this long (0-30) for the next event
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds
